# mergeah_custom_regex_rule (Resource)

Manage an organization custom regex rule. inbound_action is retained when absent from GET responses; remote drift for that field cannot then be detected.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Configure the provider as shown in examples/provider/provider.tf.
resource "mergeah_custom_regex_rule" "example" {
  name            = "Support agent"
  regex           = "CUST-[0-9]{5}"
  inbound_action  = "REDACT"
  outbound_action = "BLOCK"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Merge API field `name`. Changes require replacement.
- `regex` (String) Merge API field `regex`.

### Optional

- `context_keywords` (Set of String) Merge API field `context_keywords`. Defaults to `[]`.
- `inbound_action` (String) Merge API field `inbound_action`. Defaults to `REDACT`.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Merge API field `is_active`.
- `outbound_action` (String) Merge API field `outbound_action`. Defaults to `REDACT`.
- `score` (Number) Merge API field `score`. Defaults to `0.5`.

### Read-Only

- `defined_at` (String) Value reported by Merge: `defined_at`.
- `id` (String) Terraform resource identifier. See the Import section for its format.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mergeah_custom_regex_rule.example '134e0111-0f67-44f6-98f0-597000290bb3'
```
